title: Enterprise UI/UX
description: A ground-up redesign of the authenticated Enterprise UI/UX: an icon rail for Network, Engage, Sales, Finance, Operations and Support with an Enterprise brand square for cross-cutting views, beside a menu panel for the active module, built by nesting Sidebar parts; the inset sidebar variant can be toggled from the control panel. Each module's root route is a dashboard mock and every menu item opens a list mock, composed from ui-atoms and fed by seeded mock data. A persona control (utilities, financial, government federal) reshapes the data and copy. The rail's icons are chosen from the control panel (Cmd/Ctrl+K).

changelog.changes: Add the Operations module, make Enterprise a cross-cutting module with its own menu, give every module a dashboard as its root view, re-plan the module menus from the beacon-enterprise duplication audit, add an inset toggle to the control panel, and split the recipe into a folder, add an Overview control (overview as a menu row, or the panel header as the link), and show only a tooltip on the active module's rail button while the panel is open.

Replace the placeholder views with persona-switchable list mocks for all 33 menu items and real-shaped dashboards for all 7 modules, composed from ui-atoms and fed by seeded mock data shaped on the QA database; add a persona control (utilities, financial, government_federal); flag every concept ui-atoms cannot render with a Needs review badge.

Add contact and organization profiles reached from the Network lists: a shared detail contract and view with header, summary strip, cards, and Activity, Billing, Support and Relationships tabs, fed by a per-party generator shaped on the QA database; two new gap ids (ai-insights, mailbox).
